text:
Maria Chen: customer reports function call failing with 400: schema validation error when calling update_customer_profile. Happens intermittently after new web client roll.
Isaac Patel: can you paste the raw request + server error? this sounds like additionalProperties or type mismatch.
Maria Chen: here’s the curl we got from customer (redacted):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"tool":"update_customer_profile","args":{"customer_id":"cust_123","phone":null,"client_metadata":{"utm_source":"newsletter"}}}'
```

Server response: 400 Bad Request

```json
{"error":"SchemaValidationError","message":"additional property \"client_metadata\" is not allowed; phone: expected type string but got null"}
```

Zane - SRE: logs from runtime:

```
2026-11-02T13:02:11Z [validation] ERROR ValidationError: additionalProperty 'client_metadata' not allowed at /args
2026-11-02T13:02:11Z [validation] ERROR TypeMismatch: /args/phone expected string, got null
```

Isaac Patel: OK — two separate issues: 1) frontend is sending an extra object client_metadata that our tool schema disallows (additionalProperties=false). 2) phone is nullable on client side but schema expects string. likely caused by form sending null for empty input.
Maria Chen: customer says this started after deployed web 2.4.0 where we added analytics metadata on calls. they didn't realize it would go into toolcall body.
Isaac Patel: short-term repro: drop into curl above and try. long-term options: a) update tool schema to allow additionalProperties (risk: mask unintended fields) b) explicitly allow a client_metadata object in schema c) reject null for phone at SDK/form layer and strip nulls before sending.
Zane - SRE: my vote: make SDK defensive and strip null/undefined fields by default; also add optional client_metadata property to schema for update_customer_profile to avoid breaking legitimate telemetry. then we can do strict linting later.
Maria Chen: action items: 1) Migrate SDK to omit nulls in next patch (assigned @Isaac) 2) Add optional "client_metadata" to update_customer_profile schema (assigned @Zane) 3) Notify customer and provide workaround (strip metadata or set phone to empty string) — I'll send note.

Isaac Patel: I'll open infra PR to change SDK behavior and add test demonstrating patch. will also include a schema regression test with both extra props and null phone to catch future breaks.
Maria Chen: thanks. tagging support-bot to attach ticket: #SUP-4829 and mark high priority. :white_check_mark:
support-bot: Ticket SUP-4829 created and linked to thread 1835009999. SLA: 24h.

Zane - SRE: leaving a small snippet for the schema change recommended:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "customer_id": {"type":"string"},
    "phone": {"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}]},
    "client_metadata": {"type":"object","additionalProperties":true}
  },
  "required": ["customer_id"]
}
```

Isaac Patel: looks good. will add to PR and run packager tests.

Maria Chen: note for release notes: "SDK 0.9.3 - strip nulls from toolcall payloads; schema relaxed for update_customer_profile to accept client_metadata and nullable phone". will draft. :memo:
Zane - SRE: thanks everyone, marking as in-progress. :shipit:
